critical_code_review_comments: server.py now at 1115 lines (grew ~100 from iteration 1 for receipts/common/suggest/bin-title). Still monolithic; splitting into routers (receiving, products, bins) would improve maintainability but is NOT blocking.

/products/suggest loads ALL products (find({}).to_list(5000)) per request to build the vocab. Fine at current catalogue size but should be cached if catalogue grows; a MongoDB $text index would also work.

/products/common fallback padding when len(ids) < 6 uses find().sort('sku',1) which can collide with items already in `ids`; current implementation handles via {'id':{'$nin':ids}} filter — correct. Noted only.

bin_title regex r'^[Bb](\d+)$' only matches digit-only bin numbers after a 'B' prefix. Codes like SEC1-L2-BB22 would fall through to the else path and render 'BIN BB22' (acceptable per spec). No action needed.
receive.tsx: supplier/reference/notes are not strictly validated client-side (empty supplier allowed). Backend accepts empty strings — acceptable per spec.
receive.tsx and request/new.tsx: both call api(...).catch(toast). Error messaging is correctly surfaced. Good.

success_rate.frontend: code-verified + manager dashboard/receive/new-request screens load with correct testIDs

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test bins (TSTR-L2-B22 variants, SEC1-L2-B22 if absent) + receipts with 'rc-<uuid>' client_refs + 1 regression stock request. All non-destructive; test bins are archived at end of their tests where empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (iter2 features) and /app/backend/tests/test_drillstock.py (iter1 regression). Both use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Frontend caveat for Playwright: Expo web auth state is in zustand (in-memory) — do NOT use page.goto() to deep-link to protected routes like /receive or /request/new mid-test; instead navigate via UI (More tab > Receive, Home tile > New Request). Deep-link navigation reloads the app and loses auth state, causing /products/common and /products/suggest to 401 and render empty strips (component is implemented correctly — this is a test harness artifact, not a bug). Demo buttons on login screen: 'Driller', 'QLD Mgr', 'Admin'. testIDs added this iteration: bin-label-preview, bin-print-label, bin-receive, receive-screen, receive-supplier-input, receive-reference-input, receive-search-input, receive-did-you-mean[-corrected,-<SKU>], receive-line-<SKU>, receive-line-qty-<SKU>, receive-submit-button, common-items, common-item-<SKU>, stock-did-you-mean, request-did-you-mean, bin-name-input.
